messages.author: 5ec5102a43e29af7
messages.subject: Re: Running ggplot2 on UNIX
parts: Hi,

On Sat, Mar 20, 2010 at 09:50:56AM +0530, bogaso.christofer wrote:
> An off-topic question please. Can anyone here please clarify me what is the
> meaning of "running ggplot2 in batch mode instead of interactive" in very
> simple language? I am not a computer engg guy but study statistics.

In interactive mode you execute one command after another, by typing in
the command in a R session.

$ R
...
> x = 1:10
> y = 10:20
> plot(x,y)
...

In batch mode[1], you write all the command in a file (script) and pass it
to the R environment:

$ R < xyz.r

optionally, you can redirect the output to another file

$ R < xyz.r > xyz.out

regards,
stefan

[1] http://turing.une.edu.au/~stat356/Rbatch.html
